text:
First-person view from a raised central overlook in a bright futuristic network
museum. Four distinct buildings form a rectangle: two tall blue routing halls
on the west side, one north and one south, and two shorter amber switching
rooms on the east side, one north and one south. Exactly three wide luminous
corridors connect the buildings: the northern blue hall to the northern amber
room, the southern blue hall to the southern amber room, and the two blue halls
to each other. There is no corridor between the amber rooms. Green status lamps
mark the corridor entrances. Clear sight lines and a simple open layout make
all four buildings and their corridors visible from the overlook. Walkable
space leads toward the northern amber room. Keep buildings and corridors stable
while the viewpoint moves. No signs, text, addresses, logos or device identifiers.
This is an imaginary educational museum, not any real network.
event_text:
The corridor between the northern blue hall and northern amber room dims, and
its entrance lamp changes from green to amber. The other two corridors stay
bright with green lamps. All four buildings and all three corridors remain in
place. This is a fictional visual change, not a change to a real network.
